property_summary: For any admissible amount v, once c is funded with v wei and the owner calls sendMoney(recorder, v), the recording counterparty receives exactly v wei (rec.received() == v and c's balance drops by v); the mutant forwards 0 wei so the recorder receives 0 and violates the rule.
change_summary: Send zero value regardless of _value, so the amount forwarded to the target differs.
